title.en: An Act to Amend Sections Two and Six of Act Numbered thirty-Two Hundred and Ninety-Two, Commonly Known as the Bookkeeping Law, and Declaring Ineffective Portions of Said Act Inconsistent Herewith.

text.en:
Section two of Act Numbered Thirty-two hundred and ninety-two is hereby amended so as to
read as follows:
"Section 2. All such corporations, companies, partnerships, or persons, who, under section one hereof, are
required to keep a journal and a ledger, or their equivalents, but who keep such journal and ledger, or their
equivalents, in a language other than English, Spanish, or a native dialect, shall make a true and complete
translation of all their entries in such journal, or its equivalent, into English, Spanish, or any native dialect, and
the said translation to form an integral part of the books of account aforesaid."

Section six of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 6. Any violation of the provisions of this Act shall be penalized by a fine not exceeding one thousand
pesos or by imprisonment not exceeding six months, or both in the discretion of the court."

Any part of said Act Numbered Thirty-two hundred and ninety-two inconsistent herewith is
hereby declared ineffective.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 5, 1934.
